title: Flow Node Border and Text Element Color
description: Flow nodes still show emphasized border and text at default; fix root cause in theme sync or DAG paint.
summary: Fixed flow node border and text using emphasized colors at default. Root cause: labelFill used readableForegroundHex(canvas) and Canvas 2D overlay used the same readable-foreground for all captions. Vello theme and overlay now default to element gray; emphasized on hover/selection. Vello skips duplicate caption paint when JS overlay owns labels.
